notes.title: DEMO-PATCH NOTE 6/16
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for playing DRAW WORLD DEMO!
As of today around 5:00 PM (JST), we’ve made several updates to improve the overall gameplay experience.

===============================================

Added a link to the Steam page on the title screen

Added a function to return to the title screen from the Options menu

Adjusted encounters to prevent running into the same enemy repeatedly

Modified the card deck editing menu to allow viewing the tutorial at any time

Made several changes to the mid-to-late game maps

===============================================

We hope you continue to enjoy DRAW WORLD DEMO, and we appreciate your support for the full version as well!
